abstract: The objective of the paper is to evaluate the long‐term prospects of sustainable productivity growth linked to plausible assumptions on public agricultural R&D investments as the key productivity driver. Second, it investigates the role of changing R&D focus from yield maximization to input saving technologies (fertilizers and pesticides). The projections using CGE model MAGNET identify China, India and Brazil as regions with high productivity growth from agricultural R&D while Sub‐Saharan Africa regions will struggle with low productivity growth rates and substantial increase in GHG emissions. Overall, GHG emissions are projected to grow more than agricultural output. However it is found that sustainable agricultural productivity growth could become feasible under the reorientation of R&D programs in high income countries (with use of chemical inputs declining as much as 30%) where these policies can make an important contribution to sustainability while food security concerns are limited and spillover effects in terms of higher food prices are low.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估与公共农业研发投资作为关键生产力驱动因素的合理假设相关的可持续生产力增长的长期前景。其次，探讨了研发重点从追求产量最大化转向节约投入技术（化肥和农药）所产生的影响。利用CGE模型MAGNET进行的预测显示，中国、印度和巴西是农业研发带来高生产力增长的地区，而撒哈拉以南非洲地区则面临低生产力增长率及温室气体排放显著增加的困境。总体而言，预计温室气体排放的增长将超过农业产出的增长。然而，研究发现，在高收入国家重新调整研发项目方向（化学投入品使用量下降高达30%）的情况下，可持续农业生产力增长或可实现，这些政策在粮食安全担忧有限且食品价格上涨的溢出效应较低的情况下，能够为可持续性做出重要贡献。

title: Sustainable Productivity Growth in Agriculture: The Role of Shifts in R&D Investments and Technology
title_zh: 农业可持续生产率增长：研发投资与技术变迁的作用

abstract: Which fundraising strategy is more effective and how donation behavior changes with different monetary amounts are still open questions. This study compares the effectiveness of two fundraising strategies—suggested donation and social information—and examines how different monetary amounts affect donation behavior. We implemented a field experiment on voluntary donations among visitors to a national park. Both fundraising strategies affect donation behavior. However, the donation pattern differs significantly depending on the monetary amounts shown. Our findings provide important insights for designing fundraising campaigns and show how suggested donation and social information affect economic behavior.
abstract_zh: 哪种筹款策略更为有效，以及不同金额下捐赠行为如何变化，仍是待解之谜。本研究比较了两种筹款策略——建议捐赠与社会信息——的有效性，并考察了不同金额对捐赠行为的影响。我们在国家公园游客中实施了一项自愿捐赠的实地实验。两种筹款策略均对捐赠行为产生影响，然而，捐赠模式随所示金额的不同而显著差异。我们的发现为设计筹款活动提供了重要见解，并展示了建议捐赠与社会信息如何影响经济行为。
title: Suggested donation or social information? Evidence from a field experiment
title_zh: 建议捐赠还是社会信息？来自田野实验的证据

abstract: This paper studies the revenue-maximizing selling mechanism with a continuum of buyers who have two-dimensional private information: valuation and entry cost. Using optimal control methods, we solve this two-dimensional screening problem with endogenous entry and derive sufficient conditions under which the optimal mechanism is a posted price. These conditions reduce the original problem to a one-dimensional one in which a buyer's type is net valuation, and the optimal posted price matches that of the transformed environment. Finally, under mild conditions, revenue maximization implies underselling relative to the efficient allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在买家拥有二维私人信息——估值与进入成本——的连续统情形下，实现收益最大化的销售机制。运用最优控制方法，我们解决了这一具有内生进入的二维筛选问题，并推导出最优机制为标价销售时的充分条件。这些条件将原始问题简化为一个一维问题，其中买家类型为净估值，且最优标价与转换后环境中的标价一致。最后，在温和条件下，收益最大化意味着相对于有效配置存在销售不足。
title: Selling to a continuum of buyers with private values and entry costs
title_zh: 向具有私人价值和进入成本的连续买方群体销售

abstract: We propose a new model-selection algorithm for regression discontinuity design and related estimators. The performance of candidate models is assessed within a “placebo zone” of the running variable. Candidate models can differ by bandwidth and other choice parameters. We outline (restrictive) sufficient conditions under which the approach is asymptotically optimal, and then show the approach also performs favorably under more general conditions in Monte Carlo simulations, including simulations calibrated to well-known real-world applications. We also propose a new randomization inference procedure which draws on the placebo estimates. Our Stata commands implement the procedure and compare its performance to other approaches.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的模型选择算法，适用于断点回归设计及相关估计量。候选模型的性能在运行变量的“安慰剂区域”内进行评估。候选模型可因带宽及其他选择参数而异。我们概述了在该方法渐近最优的（限制性）充分条件，随后通过蒙特卡洛模拟显示，在更一般条件下该方法同样表现良好，包括针对知名实际应用校准的模拟。我们还提出了一种新的随机化推断程序，该程序利用安慰剂估计。我们的Stata命令实现了该程序，并将其性能与其他方法进行了比较。
title: Placebo zones in discontinuity‐based designs: Estimation, inference, and implementation
title_zh: 断点设计中的安慰剂区域：估计、推断与实施

abstract: We provide an original analysis of historical documents to describe the assignment procedures used to allocate entry-level civil service jobs in China from the tenth to the early twentieth century. The procedures tried to take different objectives into account through trial and error. By constructing a formal model that combines these procedures into a common framework, we compare their effectiveness in minimizing unfilled jobs and prioritizing high-level posts. We show that the problem was inherently complex such that changes made to improve the outcome could have the opposite effect. Based on a small modification of the last procedure used, we provide a new mechanism for producing maximum matchings under constraints in a transparent and public way.
abstract_zh: 我们基于对历史文献的原创性分析，描述了从十世纪至二十世纪初中国用于分配初级公务员职位的程序。这些程序通过试错法试图兼顾不同目标。通过构建一个将这些程序整合进统一框架的形式化模型，我们比较了它们在减少职位空缺和优先安排高级职位方面的有效性。我们证明，该问题本质上具有复杂性，以至于旨在改善结果的调整可能产生相反效果。基于对最后使用程序的小幅修改，我们提出了一种新机制，能在约束条件下以透明且公开的方式生成最大匹配。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
title_zh: 设计天意：中国帝国文官制度中的职位分配

abstract: Abstract Focusing on women entrepreneurs in a large British city, we examine how women's commercially listed businesses populated that city. Using commercial property rental records, our study allows us to understand sectoral variation and the distribution of businesses across the city and to assess both the absolute and relative contribution of women in the commercial environment. In addition to this, we examine census returns and trade directory information to understand the character of women business owners and how they came to own their businesses. We found that women accounted for 12–15 per cent of the sole trader business population and that they paid in the region of 20 per cent lower rent than equivalent sole trader men. We show differential patterns of women's business activity, with women represented most strongly in key sectors and locations associated with urban expansion. The majority of women's businesses were ‘start up’ enterprises, whereas businesses formerly extant under the name of a male relative (most often a spouse) and continued by widows were typically larger.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究聚焦于英国一座大城市中的女性企业家，探讨女性拥有的商业企业如何在该城市中分布。通过利用商业地产租赁记录，我们得以了解行业差异及企业城市分布情况，并评估女性在商业环境中的绝对与相对贡献。此外，我们还查阅了人口普查数据和行业目录信息，以揭示女性企业主的特征及其获得企业所有权的途径。研究发现，女性占个体经营者企业群体的12%至15%，且其支付的租金平均比同等条件的男性个体经营者低约20%。我们展示了女性商业活动的差异化模式，女性在关键行业及与城市扩张相关的地域中表现最为突出。大多数女性企业属于“初创”企业，而先前以男性亲属（多为配偶）名义存在、后由遗孀继续经营的企业通常规模更大。
title: Women in business: Gender and commercial space in nineteenth‐century Glasgow
title_zh: 商业中的女性：19世纪格拉斯哥的性别与商业空间

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of robot adoption on firm-level inefficiency gaps, defined as the wedge between the value of the marginal product of labor and the market wage. We develop a theoretical framework where firms endogenously assign robots and labors to different production tasks based on comparative advantage. Because robots incur lower adjustment costs than human labor, a higher robot-to-labor ratio enhances operational flexibility. abstract_zh: 本文探讨了机器人采用对企业层面效率缺口的影响，该缺口定义为劳动边际产品价值与市场工资之间的楔子。我们构建了一个理论框架，在该框架中，企业基于比较优势将机器人和劳动力内生地分配到不同的生产任务中。由于机器人的调整成本低于人力劳动，较高的机器人对劳动比率增强了运营灵活性。这种灵活性使企业能够通过更频繁、渐进式的调整来应对外生需求冲击，从而将劳动投入维持在最优水平，并缩小效率缺口。利用2000至2013年中国制造业企业的综合调查数据对该模型进行检验，我们发现10%的

title: Robots, Operational Flexibility, and Firm‐Level Inefficiency Gap
title_zh: 机器人、运营灵活性与企业层面的效率缺口

abstract: This study considers standard equity auctions in the presence of winner’s post-auction effort as bidder moral hazard. The valuation of the auctioned object is endogenously determined by the winner’s effort and private type. We characterize the equilibria of the first-price equity auction (FPEA) and the second-price equity auction (SPEA) under various environments with bidder moral hazard. Regarding performance comparison, we identify the conditions under which the FPEA features, in equilibrium, a lower equity share payment, higher total surplus, equal bidder payoffs, and a higher seller payoff in expectation. Consequently, the FPEA Pareto dominates the SPEA in terms of expected bidder and seller payoffs. We further identify the conditions under which bidder payoff equivalence does not hold while the FPEA maintains an advantage in the expected total surplus and the expected seller payoff. Lastly, we compare equity auctions with fixed-royalty auctions under bidder moral hazard and investigate equity auctions under double moral hazard.
abstract_zh: 本研究在竞标者道德风险背景下，考察了存在中标者事后努力的标准股权拍卖。拍卖标的物的价值由中标者的努力及其私人类型内生决定。我们刻画了在竞标者道德风险的各种环境下，第一价格股权拍卖（FPEA）与第二价格股权拍卖（SPEA）的均衡特征。在绩效比较方面，我们识别了FPEA在均衡状态下呈现较低股权份额支付、较高总剩余、竞标者收益相等以及预期卖方收益更高的条件。因此，在预期竞标者与卖方收益方面，FPEA帕累托优于SPEA。我们进一步识别了竞标者收益等价性不成立而FPEA在预期总剩余和预期卖方收益上仍保持优势的条件。最后，我们将股权拍卖与固定特许权使用费拍卖在竞标者道德风险下进行比较，并探讨了双重道德风险下的股权拍卖。
title: Equity auctions with bidder moral hazard
title_zh: 具有竞标者道德风险的股权拍卖

abstract: Considerable interest has emerged over the past decade in the relationship between macroeconomic outcomes and industry-level market power. The Special Issue on Market Power and the Economy contains seven original contributions offering theoretical and empirical perspectives on these subtle relationships. A brief introduction offers an overview and discussion of avenues for future research by industrial organization economists.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，宏观经济结果与行业层面市场力量之间的关系引起了广泛关注。《市场力量与经济》特刊收录了七篇原创研究，从理论与实证角度探讨了这些微妙关系。简短引言概述了这些研究，并讨论了产业组织经济学家未来研究的方向。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 106
title: The IJIO special issue on market power and the economy: An introduction
title_zh: 市场力量与经济：IJIO特刊导论

abstract: Debt accumulation and food insecurity are two pressing challenges confronting developing countries, yet evidence on their link remains limited, particularly in Africa. This study uses balanced panel data from 32 African countries (2012–2022) to examine how external debt stock and servicing affect food security. Results support the notion that “the dose makes the poison”: higher debt stock undermines food security, with effects differing across its dimensions. Elevated debt stock is also associated with higher child stunting, reflecting long-term nutritional risks. Debt servicing has an even stronger negative effect, worsening availability, affordability, safety and quality of food, as well as child nutrition. Disaggregated analysis shows that debt sources matter: multilateral loans improve food security and reduce stunting, while bilateral and private loans have the opposite effect. These adverse effects persist across income levels, food-import dependency and infrastructural development, though with varying intensity. The findings highlight the need for African countries to balance external borrowing with effective debt management and channel borrowed funds into productive, sustainability-enhancing investments that strengthen food systems and protect vulnerable populations, particularly children.
abstract_zh: 债务积累与粮食不安全是发展中国家面临的两大紧迫挑战，然而关于二者之间联系的证据仍然有限，尤其是在非洲。本研究利用32个非洲国家（2012—2022年）的平衡面板数据，考察外债存量及其偿付如何影响粮食安全。结果支持“剂量决定毒性”的观点：较高的债务存量削弱粮食安全，且其影响在不同维度上存在差异。债务存量升高还与儿童发育迟缓率上升相关，反映出长期营养风险。债务偿付的负面效应更为显著，恶化粮食的可获得性、可负担性、安全性与质量，以及儿童营养状况。分解分析表明，债务来源具有重要影响：多边贷款改善粮食安全并降低发育迟缓率，而双边贷款和私人贷款则产生相反效果。这些不利影响在收入水平、粮食进口依赖度和基础设施发展程度不同的国家中均持续存在，尽管强度有所差异。研究结果强调，非洲国家需要在外部借款与有效债务管理之间取得平衡，并将借入资金引导至具有生产性和可持续性增强效应的投资中，以强化粮食体系并保护弱势群体，尤其是儿童。
title: Teetering on the brink of debt and hunger: Empirical examination of the linkages between external debt and food security in Africa
title_zh: 摇摇欲坠于债务与饥饿边缘：非洲外债与粮食安全关联性的实证研究
